body.name: One-mechanism affine rational family
body.construction: Fix represented coordinates \(\mathcal M\in[\mathcal P]_{\mathsf M}\), \(\mathcal G\in[\mathcal M]_{\mathsf G}\), and nested \(R_F\)-rooted forests \(F'\subsetneq F\) satisfying the terminal selected-hedge predicates. Choose one local table \(\theta\) of \(\mathbf M_{\mathrm{base}}\), a rational simplex-tangent direction \(v=R_Tq\), and define \(\mathbf M(t)\) by replacing \(\theta\) with \(\theta+t v\) while holding every other local mechanism fixed.
